text:
maria: Draft RN for v2.3.0 is ready — requesting ops pin and deploybot window. Proposed change window: 2026-03-24 22:00-23:00 UTC. Pin: rwd-infer@v2.3.0

maria: Draft release notes snippet:
```
Release v2.3.0 - Serving runtime
- Reduced tail latency for long contexts
- KV-cache persistence for warm starts
- Minor API: add `max_tokens_per_request` (backwards compatible)
- DB migration: rolling index on requests.created_at
```

maria: Rollback criteria proposal: >2% 5xx OR latency >2x baseline OR output regression on QA prompts >3%.
maria: @sam @alex please weigh in. deploy-bot will run canary then full.

sam: Looks good. Can we tighten the latency trigger to 1.5x? Also add an explicit note about a short, rolling index migration so infra knows to watch I/O.

maria: Good call — will change latency trigger to 1.5x and call out "rolling index" in the RN. Updated snippet: 
```
DB migration: rolling index on requests.created_at (online, per-shard)
Rollback: >2% 5xx OR latency >1.5x baseline OR QA output regression >3%
Owners: @alex oncall, @sam infra, @jessie comms
```

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary scheduled 2026-03-24 22:05 UTC (5% traffic) -> production rollout 22:20 UTC if canary passes. CLI: `deploybot release --env prod --version rwd-infer@v2.3.0 --canary 5% --watch`

alex: I can be oncall for the window and will keep an eye on SLOs + tracing. If latency >1.5x or error spikes, I'll flip the fallback route and start rollback. :eyes:

jessie: Docs/comms copy looks fine. For the internal blast I'd add one line: "No customer-visible downtime expected; dedicated customers pinned to older minor releases are unaffected."

sam: Confirmed — infra checklist: pre-rollout infra smoke (db index plan, disk headroom, autoscaler limits) + post-canary perf capture. I'll run the smoke at 21:40 UTC.

maria: Final RN snippet for internal announce (ready to schedule):
```
Internal: Rollout of v2.3.0 (serving runtime) on 2026-03-24 22:00-23:00 UTC. No customer-visible downtime expected. DB migration: rolling index on requests.created_at (online per-shard). Rollback triggers: >2% 5xx, latency >1.5x baseline, QA output regression >3%. Owners: @alex oncall, @sam infra, @jessie comms. Deploybot: `deploybot release --env prod --version rwd-infer@v2.3.0 --canary 5%`
```

lina: Added pin entry in the console (pin: rwd-infer@v2.3.0) and scheduled the internal announce for 21:45 UTC. I'll post the blast and tag owners. ETA ~30m.

oncall-bot: oncall-bot: Reminder set for @alex at 21:50 UTC and 22:00 UTC.

maria: Thanks all :thumbsup:

maria: If no more objections I'll lock the RN and mark this thread "ops-ready" in 15m.
